title: The far side of the Moon provides clues to a previous magnetic field
summary: ETH Zurich researchers analyzed lunar samples from the far side of the Moon obtained via China's Chang'e missions, providing new evidence about an ancient magnetic field that once existed on the Moon billions of years ago.
problem_solved: Helps explain the Moon's geological history and the mechanism behind its ancient magnetic field that mysteriously disappeared over 3 billion years ago.
why_valuable: Advances our understanding of planetary magnetic field evolution and provides rare samples from the lunar far side that offer unique insights into the Moon's early dynamo history.
